title: machine-waiver.json
description: The standing machine waiver of unit S1 (plan.md:1495) at $HOME/.config/skill-master/machine-waiver.json: one record signed at the human gate by `skill_eval.py machine-waiver sign`. It binds this Mac's IOPlatformUUID (machine_id), the tools it clears (names from machine_waivable of policy/gate.rules.json, in the order claude, opencode, hermes), an expiry 90 days after signing, and the reason typed at the terminal. It binds no unit and no ruleset_sha256. The signature covers the lines skill-master-approval v1, kind machine_waiver, machine_id, tools (comma-separated), expires, reason and at (engine/approvals.py machine_waiver_payload). engine/approvals.py machine_waiver_problem checks this shape in code; this file documents it and validates registration copies.
